events.line: Ilir, you absolute coward—Omar Cooper Jr. just put up 19.3 points on your bench while you were busy jerking around with whatever wasteland you started instead, and now you get to watch everyone else's teams improve while yours stays mediocre as hell.
Ilir benched Carnell Tate and watched him drop 16 fucking points on the bench—that's what happens when you panic-check the waiver wire at 11:55 PM like your hair's on fire.

Rinor somehow managed to stumble ass-backwards into the play of the week by starting Tucker like he actually knows what he's doing—24.2 points when projections had him at 8.6, so either your waiver wire luck finally kicked in or you've been flying blind and accidentally nailed it.
Ilir, you started Bijan Robinson expecting 21 points and got 6.3—that's not a fantasy decision, that's a fucking cry for help from your entire roster.

Rinor, you absolute coward—DK went off for nearly 15 points on your bench while you were out here playing it safe with some waiver wire scrub, and now you're gonna spend all week wondering what could've been.

Arben, you absolute coward—Kamara went off for nearly 14 points on your bench while you started some committee back who couldn't find the end zone with a GPS, and now you're probably gonna lose by less than that. This is what happens when you panic and bench your studs.

Rob, Kyle Pitts just shit all over your projection like a disappointed parent at a parent-teacher conference—20.5 points when you were expecting a fucking 7.2? Maybe next time have a little goddamn faith in your tight end instead of looking like you drafted him as a lottery ticket.

Rinor really said "let me start Derrick Henry against that elite run defense" and then watched him get absolutely stuffed for 4.5 points—maybe next week you'll try this crazy thing called checking matchups before plugging in your guys.
Adam benched a guy who put up 13 points, nearly double what the so-called experts said—absolute masterclass in shooting yourself in the foot, you coward.
Arben benched Blake Corum this week and watched him put up 13 fucking points from the sideline—that's what happens when you panic-bench your guy for a "safer" play that probably shit the bed instead.
